text:
maria: quick sync — i'm consolidating open-model intake for the catalog launch. short ask: please confirm owner, license status, perf-profile owner, and any infra deps by EOD tomorrow.

maria: current shortlist:
```
vicuna-13b-v1, owner: @sam, license: Apache-2.0? needs check
mistral-instruct-7b, owner: @todd, license: CC BY-NC? flagged
ozark-3b, owner: @kai, license: MIT
```

maria: also need perf targets (p50 token latency, tokens/sec), and whether we need custom quantization.

sam: i own vicuna-13b intake. license is CC-BY-SA-4.0 per upstream — legal flagged share-alike. can we get legal to confirm compatibility with hosted API?

todd: mistral-instruct-7b — license in repo says non-commercial, but the model card is ambiguous. i'm waiting on infra for quantized build. @sasha any blockers on kernel/quant support?

kai: ozark-3b is fine from license side. perf owner = me. target p50 < 60ms @8-token prompt on a A100-80GB equiv. will provide perf script.

sasha: @kai we don't have A100 infra in prod for Dedicated tests; can you run on V100 or we can spin a short perf job on staging-gpu1. also need model param counts and HF repo link.

maria: adding deps: eng-platform for catalog metadata fields, eng-runtime for perf profiles, legal for license guidance, eng-ml for eval prompts.

legal-bot: automated check: vicuna-13b repo contains CC-BY-SA; flagged for "share-alike" — manual review required. mistral-instruct repo contains "NonCommercial" token — flagged.

sam: noted. @elena can you do a quick review for vicuna? if share-alike blocks hosted we can add it to Dedicated-only intake.

elena: will look today. quick Q: can you paste the exact model repo links? also, Sam — any downstream finetune we included?

sam: no downstream finetunes, just open weights. link: https://huggingface.co/vicuna/13b-v1

todd: on quantization — i can run 4-bit pass but need eng-runtime to validate kernel support. @sasha can we schedule a 1h pairing tomorrow?

sasha: yes, 11am PT works. i'll book a calendar invite.

maria: awesome. next milestone: finalize license decisions + perf owners for all shortlisted models by Fri (ts: 1777830000). if something can't be cleared, we gate it to Dedicated-only. any blockers?

kai: need eng-platform to add "quant_profile" field in catalog schema — filing PR now.

maria: thanks. keeping this thread for async updates, please add short status replies only. :white_check_mark:

sam: ACK

todd: ACK

elena: ACK — started review.

sasha: booked 11am PT pairing.

maria: small follow-up (2d later): elena — any news?

elena: manual review done — vicuna CC-BY-SA is incompatible with "Hosted redistributable" clause. recommendation: Dedicated-only. mistral is non-commercial — requires vendor agreement; need product sign-off.

maria: got it. moving vicuna to Dedicated lane, updating intake. thanks all.
